layers.name: Community-driven design tool reaches milestone in 14 months, sta
layers.text: Community-driven design tool reaches milestone in 14 months, staying 100% free

layers.name: October 28, 2026 — Canvix, the free and open-source design platf
layers.text: October 28, 2026 — Canvix, the free and open-source design platform, today announced that its community has created over one million designs. Unlike commercial tools, every feature — templates, exports, collaboration — remains free for everyone, forever.

layers.name: “A million designs means a million posters, menus, resumes and w
layers.text: “A million designs means a million posters, menus, resumes and wedding invites that nobody had to pay a subscription for,” said the project’s founder. “That was the whole point.”

layers.name: The milestone follows the release of the Canvix Agent Edition, w
layers.text: The milestone follows the release of the Canvix Agent Edition, which lets AI assistants edit designs through an open protocol while users watch changes live.
